native_language_semantic_policy: Native R typed FPCR uncertainty S3 scientific record replaces the Python frozen dataclass. Seeded NumPy PCG64 spawned child indices and all statistical quantities are compared; unseeded OS entropy realizations and Python runtime exception/model classes are explicitly not claimed.

case_evidence.description: Frozen Python 1.2 regression_inference.py fpca_regression_future_prediction_interval: source-typed Gaussian FPCARegressionUncertaintyResult, matched finite training response, marginal confidence mass, empirical_centered residual method and NumPy SeedSequence random state. New native source mode enforces source-scientific result type and excludes native-only index replay and base-R engine.

Actual independent Gaussian FPCR refits with 14 functional training curves, 15 time samples, seven groups with two curves each, 20 paired curve or whole-participant bootstrap refits, training target curves, retained FPC count one, normal numeric responses and seeded reproducible NumPy residual draws 0 and 121.

Fit-level centered full-reference residual distribution, single SeedSequence spawned PCG64 independent stream, row-major bounded random residual indices and targetwise addition to paired conditional-mean bootstrap predictions, NumPy-linear marginal predictive quantiles and ddof=1 sample predictive standard error; direct frozen typed Python 1.2 scientific comparison covers seven numerical array/vector fields.

Source mode rejects untyped result S3 record, non-Gaussian reference, invalid confidence, unsupported residual method, inconsistent response and fitted lengths, non-finite data, invalid prediction matrix or target grid, native-only source-index replay and base R seed engine. Exact Python exception classes are not native R constructs.

Twelve canonical ordered FPCARegressionPredictionIntervalResult source-scientific fields retaining the original source-compatible input, full centered and sampled residual matrices, additive predictive draws, lower/median/upper, predictive_se, confidence_level, residual_method, random_state and complete source provenance. Native-only RNG audit field is retained in legacy/default mode only.

Marginal per-fixed-target future noisy-response interval based on conditional-mean bootstrap resampling plus independent centered empirical full-fit Gaussian residuals under exchangeable-error assumption. Not heteroscedastic-robust, simultaneous, or joint target distribution inference.

independent_review_status: Provisional source-pinned author-reviewed science; no independent certificate and no current exact-head green CI.
language_specific_limits: Python FPCARegressionUncertaintyResult and FPCARegressionPredictionIntervalResult frozen dataclasses are represented by native R S3 scientific records; runtime identity differs.
random_state=NULL uses an R ambient stream rather than NumPy OS-generated SeedSequence entropy, so a specific unseeded sample path is not identically reproducible.
Native R requires numeric response while Python permits additional float-coercible inputs; no promise of identical Python exception classes or arbitrary object coercion.
Native seeded PCG64 implementation is bounded by exactly representable numeric integer seeds; arbitrary 128-bit Python SeedSequence seeds are beyond the native input domain.
Native-only fixed source residual indices and legacy R random engine remain supported by default, but are forbidden in strict source mode.
